negative_reviews.author: Craig S
negative_reviews.text:
First time here.
Food:
Food was lovely lots of flavour and textures were great. No complaints.

Service (Poorest):
Waitress was nice and friendly.
What put me off the most is I came with my wife and son. We ordered 2 side dishes and 2 mains and a kids bento box. My sons food turned up last. He was so hungry watching me and my wife eat, made me feel incredibly bad and guilty. Had to share ours with him.

Atmosphere:
Nice decor and music is excellent choice, lots of 80's music not to loud either.

Daily Pipe 8b feed NOT used for counts (its reviews[] caps positives at 12/site and drops comment-less reviews). negative_reviews = rating<=3 with a non-empty comment; `negatives` counts ALL rating<=3 including those with no comment. url null (not in source).
